_note: Yeongdeungpo 쪽방촌 street-heat case twin. Gate: tests/test_case_yeongdeungpo.py. Mission: docs/reports/twin_case_sites_mission_ko.md section B.

site.name: 영등포 쪽방촌 (영등포역 동·북동쪽, 영등포동 4가 일대)
site.location_method: Approximate box (about 0.9 x 1.0 km) centred 300 m north-east of 영등포역 (37.5155 N, 126.9076 E in OSM). Evidence: news places the 쪽방촌 a few steps into the alleys off 영등포역 exit 6 / 롯데백화점, in 영등포동 4가 (영신로, 영등포로34길, 경인로), designated as a public-housing district in 2020 (FnNews, Medigate, Metro Seoul); OSM has no 쪽방 tag, the 요셉의원 point (37.5153, 126.9049) and the 영등포동 address cluster lie on its west edge; the box also takes in the S-DoT sensor at 영등포로46길 4 (77 m from its centre). The exact parcel boundary was not found in a public source and is NOT used: the box is the study area, not the 쪽방촌 outline.

days_rule: Chosen from S-DoT before any modelling: for each date 2026-05-25..2026-09-06, take the median over the S-DoT sensors in the 1-3 km ring around the site centre (site sensors within 1 km excluded, at least 15 ring sensors reporting in the hour) of the hourly mean air temperature; the daily maximum of that median over local hours 10-17 ranks the days; the 5 hottest dates are used (ring-median daily max 39.7, 38.6, 38.4, 38.1, 38.0 degC). The hour of that maximum is the modelling hour. Model fit played no part.
assumptions: Building height policy osm_only: OSM height tag, else building:levels x floor_to_floor_m = 3.3 m (storey height is an assumption, typical 3.0-3.6 m for Korean buildings); otherwise the height is unknown (None). No default storey count is ever applied. Unknown buildings are an explicit footprint-only obstacle with no shadow in the main run; low (1 storey = floor_to_floor) and high (90th percentile of the known OSM heights in the site) are sensitivity runs, not results.
Terrain is flat: the Copernicus GLO-30 ground relief (a few metres across the site) is ignored; shade and SVF use building heights above a level ground.

Site box is an approximate study area around 영등포역 east/north-east (OSM + news), not the surveyed 쪽방촌 boundary. Sensors within 1000 m of the box centre are the 'site' sensors; most are therefore neighbourhood sensors, not alley sensors.

Background air temperature and humidity at the chosen hour = median of the S-DoT sensors in a 1-3 km ring around the site (site sensors excluded). This is a method choice: KMA 1 km TAMAX is local only to 2019 and as an SSP mean, so it cannot give summer 2026. The ring is itself S-DoT (urban, ~3 m high, reads about 1-1.15 degC above AWS), so absolute values carry that bias.

S-DoT timestamps (HH:07, assumed KST, assumed to label the hour) are used as the observation hour; solar position is computed at HH:07 KST. A one-hour error in this convention would shift the sun by up to about 15 degrees of hour angle.

Air-temperature offset from local built/green fraction is 0 degC per unit fraction: no Seoul S-DoT/UHI regression coefficient could be cited here, so the spatial signal in the main output is radiative (shade, SVF, surface type) only; the model reproduces none of the observed air-temperature difference by construction.

Clear sky: Haurwitz (1945) global irradiance with a fixed diffuse share of 0.2; no clouds, no aerosol. The chosen days are the hottest of the summer, which makes clear sky plausible but it is not checked against S-DoT illuminance or KMA radiation.
Wind at 10 m is 1.0 m/s everywhere (S-DoT wind is mostly missing and a street-canyon wind field is not modelled); UTCI is valid for 0.5-17 m/s.
Relative humidity is the ring median at the chosen hour, uniform over the site.

Surface classes are OSM green polygons (grass, park, wood, pitch), roads (OSM highway lines buffered by an assumed class width), and everything else; untagged ground is treated as impervious 'other'. Albedo (road 0.10, other 0.25, green 0.20) and surface-minus-air temperature excess in sun (road 20, other 14, green 5 K) and shade (3, 2, 1 K) are assumed constants, not measured.

Wall surface temperature for long-wave exchange is air temperature + 4 K, constant; wall albedo equals the ground albedo of the cell. Radiation balance uses the Lindberg et al. (2008) standing-person weights (projected area factor, half sky / half ground) in a simplified, non-iterative form.
Open structures (building = roof, carport, canopy, bridge) and underground buildings are excluded from the footprints, so awnings and canopies provide no shade in the model.

Sensor comparison samples the mean over open cells within 10 m of the S-DoT coordinate; sensors mounted on poles at about 3 m near walls may read differently from a pedestrian-height cell. Observation = hourly mean air temperature of the chosen hour, values outside 5-50 degC dropped.

The sub check compares modelled UTCI with observed air temperature minus the ring median (not UTCI vs UTCI): S-DoT has no mean radiant temperature, and with a zero air-temperature offset the modelled air temperature is constant so cannot be rank-checked. The check is diagnostic only and never changes the result.
Indoor temperature is not modelled; the 쪽방 indoor reports in the news are context only. Heat illness counts exist only at 구 level, so they select the site but do not validate the street result.
Tall buildings or sensors outside the 150 m skirt of the model domain are ignored for shade and SVF (shade reach 150 m).
